comment: The Surge vocoder also carries band count, minimum and maximum frequency, and two modulator range parameters; this build compiles those controls out, so they stay at their defaults of twenty bands. The effect itself is monophonic: a polyphonic cable into the left or right input is summed to one channel, and the outputs carry one channel.
